newsitem.title: USA: U.S. propane stocks fall by 400,000 in week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. propane stocks fall by 400,000 in week.

text.p: Warmer temperatures in the U.S. continued to moderate the draw on U.S. propane stocks, which fell last week by 400,000 barrels, the Energy Information Administration report showed Wednesday.
As of the week ending March 7, U.S. inventories were at 23.9 million barrels, slightly below the normal range for this time of year.

Regionally, stocks were mixed with the East Coast relatively unchanged. The Midwest was down by less than 100,000 barrels and the Gulf Coast fell by 300,000 barrels, the EIA report showed. ((--Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 1212 859-1631))
